params.label: Header -> value, added to every answer that does not set its own (a file's own Content-Security-Policy wins)

params.name: hsts

description_nl: 2026-10-01 portal assessment: tv, sm and katha sent no Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, nosniff or Referrer-Policy, and katha no HSTS (nginx config not in the repo). Every answer now carries these from core (core/__init__ _stamp_build), so all three sites get them from one list; change a value here, never in code. frame-ancestors lets AstroStage and the valuestream sites frame each other; CSP stays frame-ancestors only (inline styles everywhere - a full script/style policy is a later step).
weight_basis: Platform security primitive, no content. The values ARE the policy - edit them here, never in Python.
